title: Track Guide Daytona Road Course Toyota GR86 Fixed iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: Brake at last white line, 65% pressure to inside wall
corners.line: Turn in close to wall, past tires
corners.exit: Accelerate on exit, use curbing but not too much
corners.mistakes: Going over curbing too much will slow you down

corners.label: T3
corners.exit: End up on left side of track for turn four

corners.label: T4
corners.line: Up on inside curbing, be careful not to go too far
corners.exit: Accelerate on exit, stand on throttle
corners.mistakes: Going on curbing too much will unsettle the car

corners.label: T6
corners.braking: Darkening part, 80% brake pressure, easing off until top of corner
corners.mistakes: Going on throttle too early, going into grass

corners.label: T7
corners.braking: Middle of asphalt path, 60% brake pressure, easing off until yellow curb

corners.label: T11
corners.braking: break halfway between the LED banner and the one sign, 60% brake pressure
corners.line: cut the first curb on the left, barely touch the first right side curb
corners.exit: accelerate, hit the second right side curb, full throttle, hit only blue and white curbing on last curb
corners.mistakes: too much of the last curve, get a slowdown, hit the wall

general_tips: Turn one is a place where people will try and overtake you, be as close to the wall as you dare before we turn in.
Turn four is also going to be a place where people will try and overtake you, so keep that in mind when racing.
Get over to the right side of the track for turn six.
Keep in mind that people might try and overtake you into turn six.
Get a good exit out of turn seven because we're going onto a long straight with full throttle.
Stay close to the yellow line on the banking part without hitting it.
Drafting and bump drafting will play a big role.
In qualifying, get as close as you can to the outside wall without hitting it.
stay close to the yellow line on the banking section
use the top section of the banking to reduce a slowdown
battle all the way up to the start finish line
